item.title: [工具] pip
item.author: xxx@example.com (byzh)
item.description:
[工具] pip

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

pip

镜像源 

pip config set global.index-url https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple

寻找pip 

pip show pip

安装深度学习环境

1. numpy先行 

pip install numpy==1.26.4

2. numpy的附属包 

pip install scipy==1.13.1
pip install pandas==2.2.2
pip install matplotlib==3.9.2
pip install seaborn==0.13.2
pip install scikit-learn==1.5.1

3. pytorch 

pip install torch==2.7.0+cu118 torchvision==0.22.0+cu118 torchaudio==2.7.0+cu118 \
  --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118

一键sh 

#!/bin/bash

echo "【第1步】检查 pip 安装位置"
pip show pip

read -p "是否继续安装环境？(y/n): " confirm
if [ "$confirm" != "y" ]; then
    echo "已取消"
    exit 0
fi

echo "【第2步】检查默认镜像源"
# default_pypi="https://pypi.org/simple/"
# default_pypi="https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/"
default_pypi="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple"
read -p "请输入pip镜像源（默认：$default_pypi）：" pypi_source
# 如果用户直接回车，使用默认源default_pypi
if [ -z "$pypi_source" ]; then
    pypi_source="$default_pypi"
fi
echo "使用pypi镜像源：$pypi_source"

echo "【第3步】检查torch镜像源"
# default_torch="https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118"
default_torch="https://mirror.sjtu.edu.cn/pytorch-wheels/cu118"
read -p "请输入torch镜像源（默认：$default_torch）：" torch_source
# 如果用户直接回车，使用默认源default_torch
if [ -z "$torch_source" ]; then
    torch_source="$default_torch"
fi
echo "使用torch镜像源：$torch_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - basic"
pip install pip -i "$pypi_source"
pip install twine -i "$pypi_source"
pip install tqdm -i "$pypi_source"
pip install pyyaml -i "$pypi_source"
pip install python-dotenv -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - numpy"
pip install numpy==1.26.4 -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - numpy 的附属"
pip install scipy==1.13.1 -i "$pypi_source"
pip install pandas==2.2.2 -i "$pypi_source"
pip install matplotlib==3.9.2 -i "$pypi_source"
pip install seaborn==0.13.2 -i "$pypi_source"
pip install scikit-learn==1.5.1 -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - torch"
pip install torch==2.7.0+cu118 -i "$torch_source"
pip install torchvision==0.22.0+cu118 -i "$torch_source"
pip install torchaudio==2.7.0+cu118 -i "$torch_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - spikingjelly"
pip install spikingjelly==0.0.0.0.14 -i "$pypi_source"
pip install tensorboard -i "$pypi_source"
pip install cupy-cuda12x -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - cv"
pip install opencv-python==4.10.0.84 -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - byzh"
pip install byzh-core -i "$pypi_source"
pip install byzh-ai -i "$pypi_source"
pip install byzh-extra -i "$pypi_source"

echo "【第4步】开始安装 - else"
pip install gradio -i "$pypi_source"

item.title: [Linux] 镜像源
item.author: xxx@example.com (byzh)
item.description:
[Linux] 镜像源

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

镜像源

1. pip 

pip config set global.index-url https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
pip config set global.extra-index-url https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple

2. conda 

conda config --set show_channel_urls yes

替换.condarc文件：

channels:
  - defaults
show_channel_urls: true
default_channels:
  - https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/pkgs/main
  - https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/pkgs/r
  - https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/pkgs/msys2
custom_channels:
  conda-forge: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  msys2: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  bioconda: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  menpo: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  pytorch: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  pytorch-lts: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  simpleitk: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud
  deepmodeling: https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/anaconda/cloud/

3. uv

项目级 - pyproject.toml 

[tool.uv.sources]
torch = [
  { index = "pytorch-cu117", marker = "sys_platform == 'linux' or sys_platform == 'win32'" },
]
torchvision = [
  { index = "pytorch-cu117", marker = "sys_platform == 'linux' or sys_platform == 'win32'" },
]
torchaudio = [
  { index = "pytorch-cu117", marker = "sys_platform == 'linux' or sys_platform == 'win32'" },
]

[[tool.uv.index]]
name = "pytorch-cu117"
# url = "https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu117"
url = "https://mirror.sjtu.edu.cn/pytorch-wheels/cu117/" # 上交源
explicit = true # 表示 只有在 [tool.uv.sources] 明确指定了这个索引源的包，才会使用这个源

[[tool.uv.index]]
# url = "https://pypi.org/simple"
url = "https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple" # 阿里源
default = true

item.title: [Linux] 安装uv
item.author: xxx@example.com (byzh)
item.description:
[Linux] 安装uv

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

安装uv

1. 进入tmp下载uv 

cd /tmp
wget https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.9/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

官方: wget https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.9/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

加速: wget https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.9/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

2. 解压 

tar -zxvf uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
cd uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
参数 全称 作用
-z --gzip 告诉 tar：这个包是用 gzip 压缩的（因为是 .tar.gz）
-x --extract 解压/提取文件（和打包 -c 相对）
-v --verbose 显示过程：把正在解压的文件名打印到终端
-f --file 指定文件名，后面必须紧跟 tar 包名

3. 移动到 /usr/local/bin 下 

sudo cp uv /usr/local/bin
sudo cp uvx /usr/local/bin

4. 检查安装 

uv --version
uvx --version

sh 

#!/bin/bash

# 使用方法: ./install_uv.sh 0.12.9

# 传入参数
VERSION="${1:-0.12.9}"


cd /tmp
wget https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/${VERSION}/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz

tar -zxvf uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
cd uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

sudo cp uv /usr/local/bin
sudo cp uvx /usr/local/bin

uv --version
uvx --version

作者：byzh（xxx@example.com）

燃料ModFuelItem

  • 1个物品要烧10秒, 也就是200tick

原版的燃料源码

在 AbstractFurnaceBlockEntity.java 中

写法

com/byzh/diverse_draw/item/custom/ModFuelItem.java:

package com.byzh.diverse_draw.item.custom;

import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.crafting.RecipeType;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

public class ModFuelItem extends Item {

    private int burnTime = 0; // 单位是 tick

    public ModFuelItem(Properties pProperties, int BurnTime) {
        super(pProperties);
        this.burnTime = BurnTime;
    }

    // 重写 (这个方法来自 Item 的 IForgeItem接口, 是forge的扩展方法: 用于设置物品的燃烧时间)
    @Override
    public int getBurnTime(ItemStack itemStack, @Nullable RecipeType<?> recipeType) {
        return burnTime;
    }
}

IForgeItem接口内有很多很棒的方法
